pages.title: Lake Pump
pages.text: A float, a heated intake and a long hose: it draws from a Titan lake beside it, and the lake never notices.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Place it on Titan touching Liquid Methane or Cryolava: it pumps that liquid out, slowly, without ever emptying the lake.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Blood Plasma, Cryolava, Liquid Methane.
